sentences.text:
This appeal coming on for orders this day, the court pass
 the following:
 Order

This appeal has been filed by the appellant/claimant under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act,
1988, is arising out of award dated 04.09.2020 passed by 25th Member, MACT, Indore (MP), in Claim Case No.561/2015 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
(2) The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability is not in dispute, however the finding recorded by the Tribunal in this regard is not in question.

As per the finding of the Tribunal while awarding the amount of compensation has considered the entire evidence placed on record has awarded Rs.5,42,000/- with interest from the date of filing of the claim petition.

Deepak Soni vs Shailendra Kushwah on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190692922/
1 (3)

Counsel for the appellant taking exception to the impugned award contended that the amount awarded by the Tribunal was not proper as the appellant could not earn the money during the period under treatment and suffered future prospects of earning as he has suffered permanent disability from the accident and therefore the Tribunal in all fairness ought to have awarded the just compensation to the appellant which has not been done in this case.

Besides the expenses incurred on the other hand has not been properly calculated and therefore the impugned award deserves to be set-aside and prays for reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded to him.
(4) Per contra, counsel for the respondent No.2 - Insurance Company contended that Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation and argued in support of the finding recorded by the Tribunal.

(5) After hearing counsel for the parties and considering the fact that the appellant has suffered grievous injuries in the accident and initially he was admitted in the Government hospital and therefore his operation was done at Hospital at Indore.

He was admitted from 27.04.2015 to 24.05.2015 and during this period he was examined by Dr. Prateek Mahajan and from 01.05.2015 to 08.06.2015, Dr. Bhune has examined him and thereafter from 19.06.2015 to 22.06.2015, he was admitted in the Dental hospital at Indore and he was also admitted in the Aurobindo Hospital at Indore.

On perusal of the medical report of appellant, it was found that he lost his right eye vision and multiple fractures on the face and Eye specialist Dr. Pradeep Goyal had given opinion that 30%
of lost of vision in the right eye is possible and as per workmens compensation schedule, the permanent disability is taken as 30%.

Hence in the fitness of things and to strike balance between the parties and the fact that the accident had occurred in the year 2015 and at the time of incident,
the appellant was 32 years old the appropriate multiplier is16.
Accordingly, it is considered apposite to enhance the amount of compensation and the break-up of same is as under:-

Permanent disability : Income taken 5500 + 2200 (40% future prospects) =
Rs.7700/- (per month) x 12 x 30% (PD) X 16 (Multiplier) = Rs.4,43,520/-.
 Medical Expenses : Rs.3,61,000/-
 Pain and Suffering: Rs.25,000/-
 Attendant Expenses: Rs.10,000/-
 Special Diet: Rs.10,000/-
 Conveyance: Rs.13,000/-
 Loss of Wages: Rs.30,000/-
 Total Amount - Rs.8,92,520/-
 MACT Award - Rs.5,42,000/-
 Enhanced Amount - Rs.3,50,520/-
Deepak Soni vs Shailendra Kushwah on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190692922/

2 (6) The amount is enhanced from Rs.5,42,000/- to Rs.8,92,520/- and after reducing the same the total comes to Rs.3,50,520/- with interest as fixed by the Tribunal over and above the amount already awarded by the Tribunal.
(7) In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated here-in-above.

The enhanced amount i.e. Rs.3,50,520/- shall carry interest @ 9% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till its realization and the finding in respect of liability awarded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
